title: MenuScheduleOverrideRequest
description: A request to create or update menu schedule overrides for a merchant.

overrides.description: List of schedule overrides to apply.

external_id.description: External identifier for the schedule being overridden.

available.description: Whether the schedule should be active or inactive.

start_date.description: The start date and time of the override.

end_date.description: The end date and time of the override.
